name: Grafted Exoskeleton
blocked_sentences: Whenever this Equipment becomes unattached from a permanent, sacrifice that permanent

needs.what: a trigger event fired when this Equipment (or Aura) stops being attached to a permanent for any reason (re-equipped elsewhere, the Equipment leaving the battlefield, the unattach op, the creature ceasing to be a creature), binding the permanent it was attached to as the subject so the effect can sacrifice that permanent (its controller sacrifices it, if it is still on the battlefield)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has becomes_attached and leaves_battlefield but no unattach event; leaves_battlefield on self misses re-equipping and the unattach op, and nothing binds the formerly-attached permanent after the link is broken. The rest is expressible: a static pump +2/+2 and grant of infect affecting attached, and the equip keyword cost
